lateral_flank_blob_constellation.centroid_triangulation: A series of approximately four distinct vertical columns of high-intensity circular spots located posterior to the branchial region, arranged in a staggered grid formation.
lateral_flank_blob_constellation.stripe_intersections: Faint vertical bands of increased luminance intersect with horizontal rows of spots, creating visible anchor nodes in a grid-like pattern across the mid-lateral flank.

carinae_gradient_vectors.ridge_trajectory: Three parallel horizontal ridges are visible along the dorsal-lateral flank, defined by a sharp luminance gradient transition from light (dorsal) to shadow (ventral).

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: A distinct irregularly shaped pale patch, likely an abrasion or lesion, is visible on the upper lateral surface above the third and fourth gill slits.
other_distinctive_markers: A clear transition in spot morphology from high-density, small-diameter clusters on the cranial region to lower-density, larger-diameter spots on the lateral flank.
